TheSaddestSmile.NarrativeText: Arlette stops wiping the counter. 'Grandfather used to tell me about a man who wandered in here once. Didn't know his own name. Had this smile like he'd lost something he couldn't even remember having.' She looks up at you. 'You asking after your father.. reminded me.'
TheSaddestSmile.Title: The Saddest Smile

FourHundredWinters.NarrativeText: Leaf works the soil, slow. 'There was a child once. Small hands, and magic like I'd not seen in four hundred years. Then gone. The Sages said, taken for training.' She pauses. 'They smiled when they said it. Sages don't smile when they take a child.'
FourHundredWinters.Title: Four Hundred Winters

SpecialDelivery.NarrativeText: Arlette shoves three parcels at you. 'Fertilizer for Leaf, feed for Hogan, iron ingots for Eren. I can't leave the shop, so.. before lunch, please?' She grabs your sleeve. 'If they're late, Leaf lectures me. Three hours. I won't survive another.'
SpecialDelivery.Title: Special Delivery

FishForHogan.NarrativeText: Hogan waves you over. 'My pigs are mad for salmon, the good kind out the deep river. I'd fetch it myself, but..' He tips his head at them. 'They fret when I go. Boar thing.' You don't follow. The pigs just stare at you, far too hard.
FishForHogan.Title: The Rancher's Request

TheSoldiersDebt.NarrativeText: Rendall polishes a clean glass. 'I was a captain once. Held the line against a thing that walked out of a ring of stone. Then the Sages called retreat, so we retreated.' His voice flattens. 'They cut down every last one of my men on the way home. Called it an enemy defeat.' The glass cracks in his hand.
TheSoldiersDebt.Title: The Soldier's Debt

TavernCleanup.NarrativeText: Rendall tosses you a rag. 'Soldiers every night. They drink, they brawl, they leave a mess. One hour. You clean, you pour, I pay. Deal?' Simple enough. Then you're balancing five ales for drunk guards while mopping spilled stew with your feet.
TavernCleanup.Title: A Bartender's Burden

KnowledgeUnwilling.NarrativeText: Neria doesn't look up. 'Skill books, left. Portal skill? Door's behind you. I want no part of whatever this is.' But she doesn't tell you to leave. Ask it right, and she finally shuts her book. 'Fine. Sit. This'll take a while.'
KnowledgeUnwilling.Title: Knowledge, Unwilling

TheOldForest.NarrativeText: Hogan leans on the fence. 'Lived in a forest once. Beautiful place, animals everywhere.' His voice drops. 'Then some fella in a house blew himself sky high, and it all went wrong. My beasts panicked, we ran, never went back.' He shakes his head. 'They say the chairs walk now. And the teapots bite.'
TheOldForest.Title: The Old Forest

ManufacturedWars.NarrativeText: Breda watches the embers. 'Served with a supply carrier once. Everyone called him useless. Then one night he's asleep and magic's pouring off him, more than any Sage I ever met.' She goes quiet. 'Those wars never made sense. Enemies out of nowhere, orders to keep fighting. That man was your father.'
ManufacturedWars.Title: Manufactured Wars

Warrior.Title: Take the branch?

FoodNarration.Human: Both hands on the bottle, this is mine! Nobody's even reaching for it, but I'm growling anyway.
FoodNarration.Beastmen: I didn't bite it, I pounced on it... There's meat chunks on the ceiling and the floor. Don't know how, but I'm going back for more.
FoodNarration.Elf: I ate the shiny mushroom in one bite. Now my tongue glows when I yawn! I keep yawning to check.

AwakeningText.Elf: A sparrow hopped onto my crib and stared, I stared back. I'm not losing to a bird on day one!
AwakeningText.Cat: I pushed a cup off the table on purpose, then the next one... Mother's shouting now, worth it!
AwakeningText.Fox: I swapped her honey cake for a rock and watched her look for it...
AwakeningText.HighElf: I sneezed and every candle went out... then they lit again on their own, so maybe I should learn to sneeze quieter.
AwakeningText.Human: I reach for everything and my hands don't listen yet... give it time, I'll get this body working.
AwakeningText.Wolf: I howled once, just to try it. Now every dog in the village is at the door. One even brought me a stick!
AwakeningText.CorruptedHuman: My shadow moved before I did. I waved, but it waved first... I'm choosing not to think about that.

RaceCutscene.PostAwakeningNotification: Mother's still out at the fences. Nobody here to tell me no... Well, time to find something to hit.

Skill_Cripple_Warrior.Description: Hurl a stone at an enemy's leg for 100% P.Atk, crippling them to a limp (no run, no jump) for a short time.
Skill_Cripple_Warrior.Name: Cripple

Skill_SpearVolley.Description: Twelve spears wheel over her crown and fall around the compass, every one rotting what it lands on.
Skill_SpearVolley.Name: Spear Volley

Skill_Solar_Flare.Description: Channel a burning aura that damages enemies and erupts pillars of solar fire. Longer cast = longer duration.
Skill_Solar_Flare.Name: Solar Flare

Skill_SummonCourt.Description: The forest answers her: five of its creatures rise around the queen.
Skill_SummonCourt.Name: Summon Court

Skill_PoisonSpit.Description: Spits a glob of venom that pools on the ground, poisoning enemies who linger in it.
Skill_PoisonSpit.Name: Poison Spit

Skill_Tailwind.Description: Ride a gust backwards out of a corner, leaving a shredding wind where you stood. Anything still in it is cut over and over until the gust dies.
Skill_Tailwind.Name: Tailwind

Skill_Battle_Cry.Description: Toggle aura that boosts your whole party's attack. Drains MP per second with no activation cost.
Skill_Battle_Cry.Name: Battle Cry

Skill_Blade_Rush.Name: Blade Rush
Skill_Blade_Rush.Description: Dash straight through the enemy line and leave a corridor of cuts behind you. Holds two charges, so it can be spent twice before it runs dry.

Skill_Staff_Mastery.Name: Staff Mastery
Skill_Staff_Mastery.Description: Increases magic damage and MP regeneration when wielding staves.

Skill_Meteor_Shower.Description: Rain meteors from the sky onto a target ground location. Higher cast level summons more meteors.
Skill_Meteor_Shower.Name: Meteor Shower

Skill_StoneTiles.Description: Runes rise around him and a stone hunts every foe. Only a foe on a rune is spared.
Skill_StoneTiles.Name: Stone Tiles

Skill_ManaDrain.Description: Every soul near her is hooked and bled of mana, and she mends on what she drinks.
Skill_ManaDrain.Name: Mana Drain

Skill_Doombell.Description: Call a burning bell down onto the marked ground. The landing stuns everything beneath it, and the ground keeps burning until the bell fades.
Skill_Doombell.Name: Doombell

Skill_Mana_Shield.Description: Creates a mana barrier on a locked ally that fully blocks incoming hits. You can target yourself via Ctrl or HUD. Higher levels = more hits absorbed.
Skill_Mana_Shield.Name: Mana Shield

Skill_Enchant_Weapon.Description: Enchant a locked ally's weapon to deal bonus damage. You can target yourself via Ctrl or HUD. Nearby party members are enchanted too.
Skill_Enchant_Weapon.Name: Enchant Weapon

Skill_Body_Slam.Name: Body Slam
Skill_Body_Slam.Description: Leap at a spot and crash down. Everything caught in the blast is dragged to your feet and stunned. Bosses take the hit but keep their footing.

Skill_Dagger_Mastery.Name: Dagger Mastery
Skill_Dagger_Mastery.Description: Increases damage and critical rate when wielding daggers.

Skill_Aqua_Bloom.Description: Summons water blooms that home toward the locked target and burst in a splash. Longer casting summons more blooms.
Skill_Aqua_Bloom.Name: Aqua Bloom

Skill_Critical_Mastery.Name: Critical Mastery
Skill_Critical_Mastery.Description: Increases critical hit rate and critical damage.

Skill_StoneCharge.Description: Crosses the ground in one stride and lands a fist that fells everyone around it.
Skill_StoneCharge.Name: Stone Charge

Skill_RootGarden.Description: Seven great roots break ground around her and lash at anyone who strays too close.
Skill_RootGarden.Name: Root Garden

Skill_Resurrect.Description: Revive a fallen ally where they lie, restoring a fraction of their health and mana.
Skill_Resurrect.Name: Resurrect

Skill_Whirlwind.Description: Spin attack that damages and taunts nearby enemies within radius.
Skill_Whirlwind.Name: Whirlwind

Skill_Iron_Wall.Description: Fortify nearby party members with increased defense.
Skill_Iron_Wall.Name: Iron Wall

Skill_Holy_Wounds.Description: Summons household objects that home toward the locked target. Longer casting summons more objects (up to tier max).
Skill_Holy_Wounds.Name: Holy Wounds

Skill_Entangle.Description: Summons vines below the locked target, dealing damage with a chance to root. Vines also catch nearby enemies, over a radius that grows with level.
Skill_Entangle.Name: Entangle

Skill_Timber_Charge.Description: Hoist a log and charge. Anything you hit is sent flying. You cannot stop until it ends.
Skill_Timber_Charge.Name: Timber Charge

Skill_Fissure.Description: Slams the ground to erupt a line of rock, dealing physical damage and knocking back enemies.
Skill_Fissure.Name: Fissure

Skill_Recall.Description: Open a portal that pulls your whole party to your side.
Skill_Recall.Name: Recall

Skill_Cripple_Defender.Description: Hurl a stone at an enemy's leg for 100% P.Atk, crippling them to a limp (no run, no jump) for a short time.
Skill_Cripple_Defender.Name: Cripple

Skill_Blunt_Mastery.Name: Blunt Mastery
Skill_Blunt_Mastery.Description: Increases damage and armor penetration when wielding blunt weapons.

Skill_Bless.Description: Blesses the party with divine power, increasing all base stats (STR, VIT, AGI, DEX, INT, WIS) for a duration.
Skill_Bless.Name: Bless

Skill_Aqua_Nova.Description: Launches a barrage of water mortars that rain down and erupt in an area of effect.
Skill_Aqua_Nova.Name: Aqua Nova

Skill_Aurora_Wave.Description: Summons aurora bolts that home toward the locked target. Longer casting summons more bolts.
Skill_Aurora_Wave.Name: Aurora Wave

Skill_WaterPunch.Description: Lunges at the target and lands one drenching punch that drinks their mana.
Skill_WaterPunch.Name: Water Punch

Skill_SummonGoblinHorde.Description: Summons random goblins to fight alongside the caster.
Skill_SummonGoblinHorde.Name: Summon Goblin Horde

Skill_Blade_Fury.Description: Three rapid strikes in a row. Requires Sword or Blunt weapon. Pure damage, no CC.
Skill_Blade_Fury.Name: Blade Fury

Skill_Heal.Name: Heal
Skill_Heal.Description: Restore health to a locked ally. You can target yourself via Ctrl or HUD. Nearby party members are healed for less.

Skill_FirePunch.Description: Lunges at the target and lands one burning punch that keeps searing after the hit.
Skill_FirePunch.Name: Fire Punch

Skill_RuneSum.Description: A rune with a number, a digit on every head, and ten seconds to make them add up.
Skill_RuneSum.Name: Rune Sum

Skill_Blade_Circuit.Description: Vanish and slash rapidly, chaining between nearby enemies. Untouchable while slashing.
Skill_Blade_Circuit.Name: Blade Circuit

Skill_Bash.Description: A melee strike whose side effect depends on your weapon. Sword inflicts movement slow; Blunt inflicts stun. Cannot be used with Dagger or Staff.
Skill_Bash.Name: Bash

FarmSkill.Name: Anthem Bloom
FarmSkill.Description: Bangs out a rowdy tune across the plot so every crop grows a little faster.
Holds court in the middle of the plot. Your other pets fall in behind it and walk its rounds instead of their own.
FarmSkill.Name: Hollow Court

FarmSkill.Description: Walks the rows like a procession. Random fruit might take a Holy mutation, and anything dry gets watered along the way.
FarmSkill.Name: Sanctified Bloom
Coop Rally
FarmSkill.Description: Struts the pen, crowing. Your livestock level up faster.

FarmSkill.Name: War Stories
FarmSkill.Description: Bores nearby pets with old war stories until their skill cooldowns drop.
Body slams a random crop. Its growth jumps way ahead.
FarmSkill.Name: Growth Slam

FarmSkill.Description: Patrols the fence so nobody helps themselves to your fruit, and tops up whichever trough is running lowest.
FarmSkill.Name: Standing Guard

FarmSkill.Description: Waddles over to a neighbor's plot and pockets one random fruit.
FarmSkill.Name: Fruit Heist

FarmSkill.Description: Wallows through the beds and leaves a sour film. Random fruit might take a Poison mutation, and anything dry gets a soaking on the way past.
FarmSkill.Name: Rot Wallow

FarmSkill.Description: Moos a soggy, smoky omen. Random fruit might gain a Fire or Water mutation.
FarmSkill.Name: Elemental Moo
Crew Rev
FarmSkill.Description: Revs up and rallies the whole pen. All your other pets level up faster.
Casts a breezy little hex on the plot. Random fruit might catch a Wind mutation.
FarmSkill.Name: Breeze Hex

FarmSkill.Description: Picks whichever pet has been waiting longest and quietly gives it some of its time back.
FarmSkill.Name: Borrowed Hours

FarmSkill.Description: Stomps out a grounded tantrum. Random fruit might soak up an Earth mutation.
FarmSkill.Name: Ground Tantrum

Monster_CritterGoblin.Name: Critter Goblin
Monster_CritterGoblin.CodexLore: A little goblin with a plain slingshot. The pebble won't do much, but it'll rattle your head enough to freeze you for a second. Never comes at you alone.

Monster_PatchHound.Name: Patch Hound
Monster_PatchHound.CodexLore: A dog sewn together from patched rags, with buttons for eyes. Being dead never slowed it down, and it still bites. Loyal to whoever stitched it last.

Monster_SporeDeer.Name: Spore Deer
Monster_SporeDeer.CodexLore: A nervous deer trailing glitter spores. Total sweetheart. Just don't crowd it.

Monster_BarrelChampion.Name: Barrel Champion
Monster_BarrelChampion.CodexLore: A goblin with the airs of nobility. Steampunk finery, a sword in each hand, and the firm belief it's your better. Annoyingly, it fights like one.

Monster_ScarecrowGoblin.Name: Scarecrow Goblin
Monster_ScarecrowGoblin.CodexLore: A goblin playing scarecrow, plague mask and all. It freezes dead still the moment you startle it, and it can hold that pose longer than you can watch.

Monster_JunkKing.Name: Junk King
Monster_JunkKing.CodexLore: Small as a child, and the most dangerous thing in the heap. It rains meteors, flares the sky white, and calls the whole horde down when you get close.

Monster_BucketheadGoblin.Name: Buckethead Goblin
Monster_BucketheadGoblin.CodexLore: Put a bucket on its head and called it armor. Spins around begging for a fight.

Monster_CupSnail.Name: Cup Snail
Monster_CupSnail.CodexLore: A snail holed up in a cracked teacup, spitting venom. The puddle it leaves will melt your boots off.

Monster_CogCrab.Name: Cog Crab
Monster_CogCrab.CodexLore: A crab welded from old gears, running far too hot. Don't shake the claw.

Monster_TinTortoise.Name: Tin Tortoise
Monster_TinTortoise.CodexLore: Slow tin tank lobbing water mortars across the yard. Bring magic defense. Plate armor won't help.

Monster_KettleBeetle.Name: Kettle Beetle
Monster_KettleBeetle.CodexLore: A beetle wearing a kettle. Cracks the ground and knocks you off your feet. Keep moving.

Monster_Lycaros.Name: Lycaros
Monster_Lycaros.CodexLore: The Warden's hound, loosed through the Portal for you alone. Ancient, enormous, and hungry.

Monster_GrandfatherClock.Name: Grandfather Clock
Monster_GrandfatherClock.CodexLore: A wizard's clock ticking on its own schedule, and time goes wobbly for anyone standing near it.

Monster_Splinter.Name: Splinter
Monster_Splinter.CodexLore: A walking rafter with a green heart burning in its chest. Wind runs through its ribs.

Monster_Clinker.Name: Clinker
Monster_Clinker.CodexLore: The burnt one. Blue fire in the chest, charcoal for skin, and it still walks.

Monster_Anemone.Name: Anemone
Monster_Anemone.CodexLore: A drifting sea spirit far from any sea. Space folded here once, and it drifted in.

Monster_TeapotToadstool.Name: Teapot Toadstool
Monster_TeapotToadstool.CodexLore: A wizard's tea set that got cozy with mushrooms, and it is still brewing something in there.

Monster_Spigot.Name: Spigot
Monster_Spigot.CodexLore: At night the bud spits instead. Stand back from the stream and count your blessings.

Monster_LivingWardrobe.Name: Living Wardrobe
Monster_LivingWardrobe.CodexLore: A wardrobe that ate a wizard's secret notes and won't share. Slams shut on nosy peekers.

Monster_SirBrankal.Name: Sir Brankal
Monster_SirBrankal.CodexLore: A knight of stone who sleeps every night at the summit. He is waiting for someone who only wakes when he sleeps.

Monster_Nocturne.Name: Nocturne
Monster_Nocturne.CodexLore: The night parasol. Something dead lives under the cap now, and it hums.

Monster_ChairTreant.Name: Chair Treant
Monster_ChairTreant.CodexLore: A wizard's reading chair that grew into a tree, and it still wants somebody to sit in it.

Monster_Glasscap.Name: Glasscap
Monster_Glasscap.CodexLore: The same mushroom after dark, its cap gone clear and cold as glass. It still punches.

Monster_Ghostfrog.Name: Ghostfrog
Monster_Ghostfrog.CodexLore: The same frog, gone pale and half see through. Ordinary steel slides right off it.

Monster_Parasol.Name: Parasol
Monster_Parasol.CodexLore: A mushroom grown big enough to walk, and it puts its whole weight down wherever you happen to be standing.

Monster_QueenBakung.Name: Queen Bakung
Monster_QueenBakung.CodexLore: A queen of spider lilies who wakes only after dark, at the summit, in the same spot every night. She is waiting too.

Monster_Brittlecap.Name: Brittlecap
Monster_Brittlecap.CodexLore: A small mushroom with a temper and two hard little fists. The cap cracks if you hit it right.

Monster_Inklash.Name: Inklash
Monster_Inklash.CodexLore: A stump that glows purple after sundown. The roots come up black and wet, like spilled ink.

Monster_Lilac.Name: Lilac
Monster_Lilac.CodexLore: A pale moth spirit that only comes out after dark, and the light on its wings does not dim when you come close.

Monster_Sagefrog.Name: Sagefrog
Monster_Sagefrog.CodexLore: A fat green frog with a mushroom garden on its head, and it will sit there waiting while the poison on its tongue does the work.

Monster_PorcelainGolem.Name: Porcelain Golem
Monster_PorcelainGolem.CodexLore: Lab glassware that woke up huge and furious. Still just china. Break it before it breaks you.

Monster_Bellrope.Name: Bellrope
Monster_Bellrope.CodexLore: A closed bud full of teeth. It eats beetles. You it just plays with, roots first.

Monster_Rootlash.Name: Rootlash
Monster_Rootlash.CodexLore: An old stump wearing shelf fungus like a hat. Its roots reach further than you think.

Quest_TornPage.Description:
If you are reading this, you sat with the old goblin by the river and listened, and you set the four stones the way I did. I hoped it would be you. I could not know.
I came here to learn how a door between worlds is made, from the only people who ever came through one. They do not know. They were carried here, and they have spent every year since trying to build a way back. Somebody wanted four peoples at war, and when three shook hands, the fourth was made the enemy. Whose hand did it, I cannot say.
Somebody is looking for me, so I could write this nowhere but here. A man at the Castle knew more about such doors than anyone. They called him mad and he went to the forest. So will I.
I left so that the eyes would follow me and not you. Show this to no one. I mean it plain.

Quest_MartasLetter.Description:
I write this fast, so forgive the shaking hand. You saw the portal open today. That was no accident. Someone out there still hunts your father, and they follow me to find him. Every day I stay under this roof, their eyes drift closer to you. So I go, and the eyes go with me. Be angry at me. You earned it. Eat well. Sleep enough. Show this letter to no one. I have loved you since before your first breath. I mean it plain.
Marta
